title: A real decision within two minutes of an earlier same decision answers 201 and is not recorded
what_happens: The guard looks for any same decision by the same person on the incident in the last two minutes, not for the latest decision. Resolve, reopen, resolve ends Open; reopen, resolve, reopen ends Resolved. With the screens' own buttons: officer send, Send back, officer send, Send back. The second Send back answers 201 and the toast says it was sent back, but nothing is written: the case stays at 'sent', on My Tasks, and the officer never hears. Severity follows the rule that data loss is P0, though the timing is rare: the screen says done and nothing is stored.
what_should_happen: Only a true repeat is dropped: the same decision when it is still the latest one on the incident. The route's comment says the guard is for 'a double click', and any other decision or a new report between the two means it is not a double click.
repro: npx vitest run --config vitest.qa4.config.ts tests/qa/pass4/decision-matrix.test.ts -t "DECISIONS-1". On the server: the sequences in decision-matrix.json.
evidence: docs/qa/pass4/evidence/decision-matrix.json (sequences: resolve, reopen, resolve; reopen, resolve, reopen; officer send, send back, officer send, send back); tests/qa/pass4/decision-matrix.test.ts
root_cause_guess: src/app/api/collector/decisions/route.ts:85-88 (the 'recent' query checks decision = ? in the window, and ignores what came after it)
class: data loss: a decision silently dropped

title: "Verify and close" does not close the incident on the console, while the officer and the citizen are told it is closed
what_happens: The confirm box says "Verify and close", the button's hint says "The work is done: close it", the toast says "The citizen will see it closed", and the citizen reads "The Collector's office checked the work and closed the complaint". The officer's stage becomes Verified. But effective.ts leaves the status alone: the console's page, list, tiles, map, briefing, Trends, Ask District IQ and Jarvis all still count the incident as open. The officer's own page then shows two different open figures: the board against New + In action + Sent (see the sums in the evidence). The route's comment says the pipeline applies decisions on its next build, but district_intel reads the decisions only to learn priority weights (dintel/priority.py, dintel/mysql_export.py creates the table), so nothing ever closes it.
what_should_happen: One state. Either verify closes the incident on every surface, or the words to the Collector, officer and citizen stop saying closed. The words and the citizen's tracker are the promise, so the likely fix is to add verify to DECISION_EFFECT as closed. This is a decision about the rule: effective.ts states the current behaviour on purpose, so the owner should choose.
repro: npx vitest run --config vitest.qa4.config.ts tests/qa/pass4/decision-matrix.test.ts -t "DECISIONS-2". On the server: the verify row of the matrix, and the sum rows for the officer's page.
evidence: docs/qa/pass4/evidence/decision-matrix.json (actions: verify; sums rows 'open on the board against New + In action + Sent'); src/components/collector/app/CollectorApp.tsx:537; src/components/collector/app/Attention.tsx:130
root_cause_guess: src/lib/collector/effective.ts:10-14 (verify has no effect) against src/app/api/collector/decisions/route.ts:57 and src/lib/officer/data.ts:76-78
class: words and state disagree across roles

area: Collector decisions: escalate and verify after a resolve
title: An escalate after a resolve reopens the incident on the console while the officer and the citizen still see it closed
what_happens: effective.ts takes the latest non-note decision, and escalate has no effect, so the pipeline's open status comes back. After resolve then escalate the console shows Assigned and open; the officer's stage stays Verified (STAGE_SQL does not read escalate) and the citizen's tracker stays Verified by Collector. A verify after a resolve does the same; effective.ts names that case. The screens have no Escalate or Resolve button today, so only the route reaches this, but the route is the documented way in.
what_should_happen: "verify and escalate leave the status as it is" (effective.ts): an incident a resolve closed stays closed until a reopen. The latest decision that has an effect should decide.
evidence: docs/qa/pass4/evidence/decision-matrix.json (sequences: resolve, then escalate; severe: resolve, then verify)
root_cause_guess: src/lib/collector/effective.ts:36-37 (latest ignores only notes, not escalate or verify); same in src/lib/collector/intel.ts:386 decisionsFor and src/lib/map/world.ts:378

title: A model-written query's "still open" and status do not follow a decision
what_happens: compile.ts runs plans straight on the incidents table. A plan with is_open = 1 on one incident gives 1 before and 1 after a resolve, while the console says 0. A plan with status_std = 'Resolved' gives 0 after it. The whole path gives the same: a question, a fake agent step and plan, the real compile, the real store and the real card, whose headline says "1 incidents". The catalog offers is_open as "still open" and marks ops.collector_decisions "not for answers", so a model has no right way to ask. This was tested with a fake model at the boundary, because the server has no model key. OPEN-16 listed this as P2; by this pass's rule a wrong number is P0.
what_should_happen: "every number the assistant states is a number the console shows" (tools.ts). The compiled query reads the effective flag and status.
evidence: tests/qa/pass4/decision-matrix.test.ts (describe OPEN-16: the two readers on the pipeline's flag)
root_cause_guess: src/lib/assistant/compile.ts runs on the incidents table with no decisions laid on top; src/lib/assistant/catalog.ts:72-73 offers is_open as still open, and :365 marks the decisions not for answers

area: Ask District IQ: the search index (OPEN-16)
title: The search index's open-only filter and its status do not follow a decision, even after a sync
what_happens: rows() in lance.ts reads is_open and status_std and never the decisions, so a sync sees no change. After a resolve and a sync, an open-only search still returns the incident, with open = 1 and its old status, which search_records shows. After a reopen and a sync, an open-only search still misses it. Tested on the real syncLance and hybridSearch in a scratch folder, with a fake embedding at the boundary, because the embedding model file in this worktree is a 134-byte pointer and no index exists here. The live server has no index, so it answers from the keyword lane (DECISIONS-4).
what_should_happen: "records that only changed status are rewritten with their old vector" (lance.ts): the record's status is the effective one, and a decision reaches the index.

area: My Tasks: an officer's report on a reopened incident
title: An officer's report on an incident the Collector reopened never reaches My Tasks
what_happens: The pipeline had closed the incident, the Collector reopened it and sent it to the department, and the officer did the work and sent the report. The route answers 201 and the officer's stage says Sent, but sentByOfficer() requires the pipeline's i.is_open = 1, so the report is not on My Tasks and not on the awaiting list. Nobody can verify it, and the officer has no way forward. The screens' Send back appears only on My Tasks rows, which the pipeline still has open, so today only the route reaches this; by reading the code (not run), a pipeline close after the officer approved the case would reach it too.
what_should_happen: "Such a report always comes to My Tasks (the officer asked for the Collector's check), whatever the period" (intel.ts): use the effective open flag.
repro: npx vitest run --config vitest.qa4.config.ts tests/qa/pass4/decision-matrix.test.ts -t "DECISIONS-15". On the server: sequence 'reopen an incident the pipeline closed, then the officer sends a report'.
class: reader on the pipeline's flag; stuck work

title: After a reject and a reopen the citizen still reads the reason it was rejected
what_happens: syncComplaints writes the reason into the complaint's remarks on the reject. On the reopen it writes COALESCE(null, remarks), so the reason stays. The tracker page shows it as "Remarks: ..." under the status In Progress, as if it were the current word on the work.
what_should_happen: A rejection's reason goes with the rejection. progressOf already clears it ("if (last.status !== 'Rejected') rejectedStage = null, remarks = null"), so the write should clear the stored reason too, and leave any remarks that were not a rejection's.
root_cause_guess: src/lib/complaint-progress.ts:167 (COALESCE(?, remarks)); src/app/api/complaints/[code]/route.ts:73 and src/app/api/complaints/route.ts:355 keep the stored remarks
class: stale words after a state change
